pool.text: An overland Spanish exploration party arrived at San Francisco Bay.
The Spanish ship San Carlos became the first ship to anchor.
Settlers established the Presidio of San Francisco at the Golden Gate.
Perhaps the first historical observer record was from the De Anza Expedition.
Juana Briones de Miranda was granted a small rancho at El Polín Spring.
Mayor Bartlett ordained that the city should officially change its name.
The city simultaneously constructed the San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge.
The Golden Gate Bridge was completed during the Great Depression.
The United Nations Charter creating the United Nations was drafted.
The Treaty of San Francisco re-established peaceful relations with Japan.
Hippies flocked to Haight-Ashbury reaching a peak with the Summer of Love.
California Institute of Integral Studies was founded to offer graduate programs.
Bank of America completed the skyscraper at 555 California Street.
KPOO began operating as an independent African-American owned radio station.
The Transamerica Pyramid was completed, igniting a wave of Manhattanization.
San Francisco Pride events began being held continuously every year.
Sutro Tower was built as an important broadcast tower for television stations.
San Francisco officially declared itself to be a sanctuary city.
The Loma Prieta earthquake caused destruction and loss of life.
Rikki's opened as the first and only women's sports bar in the city.
